the study of calcium binding to peripheral nerve membrane.
the elucidation of the mechanism of action of Ca2+ at the molecular level.
the study of the role of calcium in the physiology and pathology of the nervous system.

Tb3+, like Ca2+, binds specifically to lobster nerve membrane vesicles, and that Tb3+ binding can be inhibited by Ca2+ and Mg2+.
